# Фелиниды
Felinids, the term for instances of SCP-3720-1 that are roughly three months into their transformation, possess claws that inflict slashing damage in melee combat, as well as a distinctive "cat-like" accent. They have toggleable night vision. They can lick their wounds, which helps stop bleeding and accelerate recovery.
In terms of defense, they differ slightly from standard humanoids. They receive [color=#ffa500]10% more crushing, cutting, and piercing damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]10% more Heat damage[/color], но [color=#1e90ff]10% less Cold damage[/color].
Felinids are compact enough to fit in a bag if necessary.
